g.text: Limited concessions can protectthe fund's ability to operate
Ease funding strain and reduce non-performance risk
Share the burden and support LP confidence
TPG could accept limited economic concessions to preserve reliable LP support.

Source: Case letter terms (p. 1), read with the evidence on slides 9–12. A possible explanation: it does not prove defaults were avoided, confidencerestored or fundraising improved, nor that every LP will take the reduction.
